post.description: Reports a web event to TikTok Conversions.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

testEventCode.description: Optional TikTok test event code for non-production validation.

data[].event.description: Standard or custom TikTok event name.

data[].event_time.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for when the event occurred.

data[].event_id.description: Optional deduplication identifier shared with Pixel events.

data[].user.email.description: User email. TikTok recommends SHA-256 hashing when applicable.

data[].user.phone.description: User phone number. TikTok recommends SHA-256 hashing when applicable.

data[].user.ttclid.description: TikTok click identifier from the landing URL.

data[].properties.currency.description: ISO currency code for the event value.

data[].properties.content_type.description: TikTok content type, such as product or product_group.

data[].properties.query.description: Search query associated with the event.

data[].properties.description.description: Description associated with the tracked event.

data[].properties.contents[].brand.description: Brand associated with the content item.

data[].page.url.description: URL of the page where the event occurred.

data[].page.referrer.description: Referrer URL for the page view.

code.description: TikTok provider status code returned by the Events API.

request_id.description: TikTok request identifier for support and debugging.
